## Lisbon Four-Day Plan for Two Adults
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg

A balanced 4-day Lisbon trip focused on historic neighborhoods, seafood, and one easy day trip. I’m assuming you want a comfortable moderate-budget pace with public transit or rideshares, and that the €1,200 total excludes flights but includes lodging, food, local transport, and entrance fees.

## Day-by-Day Itinerary and Budget
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

| Day | Focus | Transit suggestion | Estimated cost for 2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Apr 10 | Baixa, Alfama, Castelo | Metro to Baixa-Chiado; walk uphill; tram or tuk-tuk only if needed | €220 |
| Apr 11 | Belém + riverside | Tram 15 or train + walking | €190 |
| Apr 12 | Sintra day trip | Train from Rossio + local bus or short taxi | €260 |
| Apr 13 | Bairro Alto, Chiado, Time Out Market | Metro + walking; taxi late evening if needed | €170 |
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/83/Lobster%2C_Time_Out_Market_Lisboa_%2850661858143%29.jpg Alt=| Apr 13 | Bairro Alto, Chiado, Time Out Market | Metro + walking; taxi late evening if needed | €170 |, Lisbon, Portugal

### Day 1: Historic Core and Alfama
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Check in, then start in Baixa and Rossio; stroll Rua Augusta and Commerce Square.
- Afternoon: Explore Alfama, Lisbon Cathedral, and the Castle area; keep this day light on formal sightseeing and let the neighborhood be the main event.
- Dinner: Seafood-focused meal in Alfama or nearby Baixa; book a table if you want sunset views.
- Budget: €220 for lodging share, transit, coffee/snacks, and one sit-down meal.

### Day 2: Belém and the Riverfront
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Tram or train to Belém; visit Jerónimos Monastery exterior, Belém Tower area, and the Monument to the Discoveries.
- Afternoon: Walk the riverside path, then choose one museum only if energy is high; otherwise keep it relaxed and scenic.
- Dinner: Return to central Lisbon for a moderate seafood dinner in Chiado or Cais do Sodré.
- Budget: €190 for transit, pastries, light admissions, and dinner.

### Day 3: Easy Day Trip to Sintra
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/train-front.svg
- Morning: Take the early train to Sintra and head straight to the historic center or one major palace.
- Afternoon: Pick one highlight only, such as Quinta da Regaleira or Pena Palace, then enjoy a slow lunch before heading back.
- Dinner: Casual dinner in Lisbon after return; keep this simple because Sintra is the full-day effort.
- Budget: €260 for round-trip transit, one attraction, buses/taxi buffer, lunch, and dinner.

### Day 4: Chiado, Bairro Alto, and a Final Food Stop
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: Coffee and pastries in Chiado, then browse bookshops and elegant streets.
- Afternoon: Wander Bairro Alto and nearby viewpoints; keep this flexible for shopping, photos, or a long lunch.
- Dinner: End at Time Out Market or a nearby seafood restaurant for a low-stress final meal.
- Budget: €170 for transit, lunch, snacks, and one final dinner.

## Moderate-Budget Food Ideas

- **Marisqueira meal**: grilled fish, clams, or octopus with wine; good target spend is **€45–€70 for two**.
- **Tasca lunch**: daily specials, codfish, soup, and dessert; good target spend is **€25–€40 for two**.
- **Market-style dinner**: share small plates at a food hall or casual seafood counter; good target spend is **€35–€60 for two**.

## Cost Check for the Full Trip
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/currency-euro.svg

- Lodging: about **€600–€750** for 4 nights, depending on neighborhood and hotel level.
- Food and drinks: about **€280–€360**.
- Local transport: about **€40–€70**.
- Entry fees and day trip extras: about **€120–€180**.
- Total target: **€1,040–€1,360**.

To stay inside **€1,200**, aim for:
- Lodging around **€650 max**
- One major paid attraction per day at most
- A mix of casual lunches and 2 nicer dinners
